company.name: Clearwell Air
company.description: Fictional indoor air quality startup in Doha. Distributes in-duct HVAC purification units and portable purifiers made by a US manufacturer, and runs before-and-after building assessments to prove the equipment works in real rooms.
company.note: All names, people, sites and numbers in this repo are made up for demonstration.

programs.name: Portable unit launch
programs.goal: Launch the portable purifier (HEPA, carbon and active purification) to offices and villas through two retail partners.

programs.name: School group pilot (in-duct units)
programs.goal: Fit in-duct purification units to the air handlers serving 12 classrooms and prove the impact with a post-install assessment.

programs.name: Assessment service v2
programs.goal: Standardize the before-and-after assessment protocol (mold, VOCs, particles, CO2) so every report is comparable across sites.

programs.name: ERPNext field service rollout
programs.goal: Move work orders, inventory and technician scheduling from spreadsheets into ERPNext.

programs.name: Q4 stock import
programs.goal: Import Q4 units, replacement cells and filters from the US manufacturer and keep 8 weeks of service stock on hand.

programs.name: Field technician hiring
programs.goal: Hire and certify 3 field technicians to support installs and assessments.

programs.name: Investor update pack (Q3)
programs.goal: Send the Q3 investor update with pipeline, cash runway and customer impact results.
